name: Glassboro
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Glassboro, NJ 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Glassboro, New Jersey for 2026: Boro in Lights, North Pole at Harbaugh Village and Night of Lights at Creamy Acres Farm.
lede: Glassboro lights up downtown with Rowan University for Boro in Lights, and nearby Mullica Hill adds a village North Pole and a farm light show.
celebrates: The Borough of Glassboro and Rowan University light downtown for Boro in Lights, an annual tree lighting and festival along Rowan Boulevard, which Rowan's centennial pages describe as sponsored by the borough, businesses and community organizations and drawing thousands to celebrate the season. Santa lights the tree at 6:30 pm in Town Center. A few miles away in Mullica Hill, Harbaugh Village runs its North Pole on weekends and weeknights into late December, and Creamy Acres Farm turns its fields into a Night of Lights.
lastyear: Boro in Lights returned on Friday, December 5, 2025, from 6 pm to 9 pm in downtown Glassboro, presented by Nexus Glassboro and Rowan University, with Santa lighting the tree at 6:30 pm, according to the borough's posts. Rowan's student paper has covered earlier editions, saying hundreds of adults and children gathered along Rowan Boulevard for the tree lighting and Christmas festival.
facts: Boro in Lights has been running long enough that Rowan University's centennial history site features a 2019 edition under the headline Hometown Holiday Spirit. The 2025 festival was presented by Nexus Glassboro together with the university. Rowan's student newspaper describes it as bringing Glassboro and Rowan together.
trains: We did not find a Christmas train ride in Glassboro. Our New Jersey guide at /blog/christmas-train-ride-new-jersey lists the Christmas train rides across the state, and Philadelphia's holiday railway at the Morris Arboretum is listed on our Philadelphia guide.
traditions: Downtown Glassboro's tree lighting and festival on Rowan Boulevard with Rowan University.
Santa lights the tree at 6:30 pm in Town Center.
A ticketed village North Pole in Mullica Hill.
Night of Lights at Creamy Acres Farm
A farm light show with a drive-thru and hayrides.
kidfact: At Boro in Lights Santa himself lights the downtown Christmas tree.
faq: The borough and Rowan University hold Boro in Lights downtown, with Santa lighting the tree, and nearby Mullica Hill adds a village North Pole at Harbaugh Village and a Night of Lights at Creamy Acres Farm.
Yes. We list Boro in Lights as free. The Mullica Hill events are ticketed.
What time does Boro in Lights start?
The 2025 festival ran from 6 pm to 9 pm with Santa lighting the tree at 6:30 pm. Check the borough's listing for the 2026 hours.
Where are Mullica Hill's Christmas events?
Harbaugh Village and Creamy Acres Farm are both in Mullica Hill, a short drive from downtown Glassboro.
sources: Boro-in-Lights brings Glassboro and Rowan together
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Glassboro for 2026, and here is what he found: 3 family events, 1 of them free. The magic runs from November 27 (North Pole at Harbaugh Village in Mullica Hill) through December 24 (Night of Lights at Creamy Acres Farm), with 13th Annual Boro in Lights in downtown Glassboro (December 4) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Glassboro

  • 3 Christmas events for kids in Glassboro and nearby Mullica Hill
  • 1 free event: 13th Annual Boro in Lights in Downtown Glassboro
  • Meet Santa: North Pole at Harbaugh Village (November 27 to December 23) and Boro in Lights (December 4)
  • Tree lightings and lights: Boro in Lights (December 4) and Night of Lights at Creamy Acres Farm (December 4 to 24)
  • Season: November 27 to December 24

Planning a bigger day out? Glassboro families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Philadelphia, which covers the Philadelphia Christmas Village, the Franklin Square Electrical Spectacle and the Morris Arboretum Holiday Garden Railway.
